title: Timepoint 3 — Drainage needs resolved (still awaiting transplant)
scenarioBrief: You are the intern following Sarah Whitlock. Today is 7/5/2027. Review the chart before answering.

chartGate._notes: TP3 visibility: the full chart through early July — TP1/TP2 records PLUS the transplant evaluation/listing note and the interval hepatology note documenting improvement after stopping FFP and placing the PleurX (off scheduled drainage, Na improved to 130). prompts.question: Her need for paracentesis and thoracentesis has dropped away almost entirely. What are the possible reasons for this adjustment in her drainage needs?

scoringRubric.rubricText:
Total 3 points. Three of the five of the following (1 each up to 3):
- Reduction in total volume of blood products
- Changed alcohol intake
- Improved adherence to diuretics
- Improved nutrition
- Less salt in diet
APPLICABLE MAXIMUM: 3.
